title.en: No static check is switched off in place

summary.en: A suppression directive silences a static check for a line or a file; the finding it hides is left unresolved.

en: A check was about to be switched off in the code.
I am fixing what it flags instead, so the check keeps protecting the project.
fr: Un contrôle allait être désactivé dans le code.
Je corrige plutôt ce qu'il signale, pour qu'il continue de protéger le projet.

reason.en: A suppression that switches off a static check was found: an eslint-disable, a @ts-ignore or @ts-expect-error, a @phpstan-ignore or @psalm-suppress, a noqa or type: ignore, a nosemgrep, a gdlint:ignore, or a Rust allow attribute. Remove it and fix what the check flags; silencing the tool hides the finding rather than resolving it. Analyser configuration files, where an exception is declared deliberately, are outside this standard by their paths.
